milestone: W9B combined unique-frame + optical scene-to-visible latency trial
objective: First W9B trial. Transport, pacing, budgets, camera, transform and Host are IDENTICAL to the accepted W8-005 run; nothing about the protocol is being retested. What is new is only what is observed: the W9A monotonic source identity is now carried through selection telemetry, and the scene in front of the camera is the deterministic motion-truth stimulus, filmed simultaneously with the Ditoo by an external high-speed camera. Purpose is to separate camera/source cadence, scheduler selection, transport completion and physical display behavior, and to measure true scene-to-visible latency. No rate ladder, pipelining, retry, reconnect or reclaim.

readiness.required_followup: Do not replay attempt 006. Preserve its evidence. W9B still has no optical evidence. If another physical trial is justified, use a fresh reviewed identity with a new exact grant.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target; no target override

transport.connection_shape: one connection; one frame in flight; one ACK per frame
transport.one_controller_rule: After a fresh named grant only: stop the MCP product supervisor and verify its session closed; Android Divoom app disconnected. OpenTivoo and port 8779 untouched. Restore MCP separately under its existing Runtime 003 policy after terminal close.

build.identity_note: W9B-006 runner rebuilt/staged with W9A source identity. 40 ms failure reproduction, 50 ms pacing-margin control, cross-clock telemetry regression, W9A identity control, parity, and real read-only Host status checks passed. Transport unchanged from accepted 005. Host/Runtime 003 unchanged; no claim/session/device I/O.

session.shape: Unchanged from accepted W8-005: ACK-gated with a 50 ms absolute client dispatch-start floor against the unchanged 40 ms Host streaming backstop, 10 ms arrival-jitter margin, prior ACK always required, zero packet spacing, pipelining forbidden. W9B changes observation only, never transport.

stream.source_description: NexiGo VID_0C45 PID_2690 live camera pointed at the deterministic W9A motion-truth stimulus on an external monitor; WinRT Realtime freshest-frame slots; fixed srgb_area transform and deterministic 255-colour guard. The stimulus is a real scene filmed live, NOT a prerecorded frame bundle.

live_source.producer_description: W8-005 producer plus W9A source identity. A monotonic SourceId is assigned once at successful acquisition and propagated raw slot -> transform -> ready slot -> sender selection; the sender emits bounded sourceIdentity evidence. Transport code path, pacing and budgets are unchanged from the accepted 005 run.

camera.observed_rate_exception: Exposure-quantised 30 fps previously measured; see route section 11. Re-measure in trial preflight, do not promise 60 fps.

transform.palette_guard: closest weighted-colour pair, deterministic scan-order tie break, applied last

live_source.privacy: No saved camera stills or video; metrics only

optical_observation.stimulus: tools/w9a_motion_truth_stimulus.html driven by requestAnimationFrame at the monitor refresh rate
optical_observation.stimulus_decoder: host/motion_truth.py 4x4 cell code; all 4096 counter values verified to round-trip the real production transform
optical_observation.analysis: host/w9b_optical.py via cli/w9b.py; offline, file-only, no device surface
optical_observation.external_camera: operator phone slow-motion; monitor and Ditoo must share one exposure so no clock alignment is required
optical_observation.quantisation_note: 240 fps footage quantises latency to ~4.167 ms; report it, never interpolate through it.
optical_observation.not_evidence_of: Optical results are physical-display evidence only. They are never transport evidence, and transport FPS is never panel FPS.

budgets.derivation: min(floor(10000 / 50) + 1, 500) = 201 frames; 201 * 3 = 603 packets; canonical encoder worst-case is 1054 application bytes including both preambles, so 201 * 1054 = 211854 bytes.

stop_immediately_on: camera missing or no valid first frame before claim/open
Host profile not confirmed as streaming_ack_clock
target, firmware, source or executable hash mismatch
any Host refusal, HTTP/send fault or ACK timeout
malformed or unexpected report / canvas invalidation / stock takeover
10 second lifetime or frame/byte budget reached
stop_policy.on_camera_disconnect: Stop new submissions, allow an already-submitted frame to settle, request close once. Ambiguous close is unknown. Never resend, reconnect or reclaim.
stop_policy.on_host_fault: Terminal unknown; never resend or retry; cleanup must not overwrite unknown.
stop_policy.source_cleanup: Cancel capture/processor and dispose the reader/camera. Collection-continuation flag refers to existing MCP collection, not retaining webcam capture.
stop_policy.recovery: Restore the MCP product separately under Runtime 003 after verifying experiment terminal ownership; do not overlap controllers.

acceptance.transport: Identical bar to accepted 005: one clean 10-second run, zero retries/reconnects/reclaims/pacing refusals/encoder-hash mismatches, one frame in flight, queue depth max <=1.
acceptance.rate: No rate target. 005 already characterized rate; re-measuring it is not the purpose and no ladder may be created.
acceptance.source_identity: Monotonic source ids with zero duplicate and zero out-of-order selections. Report first/last selected id, last acquired id, skipped-between-selections and the selected-id series.
acceptance.optical: At least 30 clearly decodable transitions correlated between monitor and Ditoo. Report p50/p95/min/max scene-to-visible latency, visible unique transitions, visible repeats, skips, undecodable counts and any impossible negative matches (excluded, never averaged in).
acceptance.separation: Report camera/source cadence, scheduler selection, transport completion and physical display behavior as four separate categories. Never infer panel refresh from ACK or transport throughput.
acceptance.visual: Owner observation of tearing, artifacts and whether the stimulus reads correctly on the panel.

persistence_analysis.forbidden: firmware, gallery/persistent uploads, raw send, target selection, command enumeration, pipelining
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; Runtime 003 is not webcam authority

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE 10-second W9B live-camera optical/identity trial to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 v42012 via existing typed Host 127.0.0.1:8796 and streaming_ack_clock profile; transport envelope identical to the accepted 005 run (40 ms Host floor, 50 ms client dispatch floor, at most 201 frames / 603 packets / 211854 application bytes, one connection, one frame in flight, zero packet spacing); no retry/reconnect/reclaim/pipelining and no rate ladder; camera points at the deterministic motion-truth stimulus and an external camera films the monitor and Ditoo simultaneously; suspend and restore Runtime 003 separately. Grants for 001-005 are consumed and confer nothing.

adapter.claim_handshake: Runner must produce one fresh valid 16x16 frame and emit camera_ready + nonce before WSL creates the durable one-use claim; only execute:<nonce> may cross the claim boundary.
adapter.deployment_state: PASS W8-005 preparation: rebuilt/staged/frozen with 50 ms margin and corrected cross-clock telemetry semantics; no claim/session/device I/O.

w8_failed_baseline.diagnosis: Host ACKed frame 9; client rejected it only because of invalid cross-clock telemetry comparison.

w8_accepted_baseline.note: 005 established the transport result. 006 reuses that exact envelope and adds observation only.

w9b_framing_verification.note: Camera-only probe stills decoded through the real production transform. Establishes framing and decode only; no transport, latency or panel behaviour is established here.

w9b_attempt.diagnosis: Device did not ACK within the 5000 ms budget. Not a code, hash, authority, pacing or camera fault.
